fields.description: Until this is on, the Communication screen does not offer WhatsApp at all.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Where the society's open-wa gateway answers, without a trailing slash. For example http://localhost:2785, or https://wa.example.org behind your own certificate.
fields.label: Gateway Address

fields.description: The identifier of the linked session on that gateway. It is created once, when the society's phone scans the code, and does not change afterwards.
fields.label: Session

fields.description: A key from the gateway with permission to send. Stored encrypted and never shown again once saved.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Seconds to wait between messages. Sending a broadcast in a burst is what gets a number restricted; this is the setting that stops that, and lowering it is a decision about the society's own number.
fields.label: Seconds Between Messages

fields.description: Vary the wait either side of that figure, so the sending does not arrive on a metronome.
fields.label: Vary The Wait

fields.description: The most messages to send in one day, across every broadcast. Zero means no limit. A broadcast that reaches the limit stops and finishes the next day; nobody is dropped.
fields.label: Daily Limit

fields.default: Reply STOP to stop receiving messages from us.
fields.description: Added to the end of every broadcast. Clear it to send nothing extra.
fields.label: Opt-Out Notice

fields.description: One word per line. A reply that is only one of these words takes that number off the list. Add the word your own volunteers would actually use in their own language — the two here are a starting point, not a complete list.
fields.label: Opt-Out Words

fields.description: A secret of your choosing. Set the same value as a header on the gateway's webhook so this site can tell a real reply from anything else that finds the address.
fields.label: Webhook Token
